metrics.name: Retention Policies Count
metrics.gotcha: Exists only in the Users/Files layout; empty on all test systems. length() errors when the key is absent.

metrics.name: Admin User Count
metrics.gotcha: Roles observed: admin, coadmin, user. Box dataprints come in two layouts (Members/Enterprise/SecuritySettings vs Users/Files/RetentionPolicies); this path exists only in the first.

metrics.name: Storage Quota Total (bytes)
metrics.gotcha: Sum of per-user quotas in BYTES (no GB conversion in JMESPath). Box dataprints come in two layouts (Members/Enterprise/SecuritySettings vs Users/Files/RetentionPolicies); this path exists only in the first.

metrics.name: Storage Used (bytes)
metrics.gotcha: Sum of per-user usage in BYTES. Box dataprints come in two layouts (Members/Enterprise/SecuritySettings vs Users/Files/RetentionPolicies); this path exists only in the first.

metrics.name: Active User Count
metrics.gotcha: Members[].Status is lowercase "active". Box dataprints come in two layouts (Members/Enterprise/SecuritySettings vs Users/Files/RetentionPolicies); this path exists only in the first.

metrics.name: Inactive User Count
metrics.gotcha: Non-active status values not yet observed. Box dataprints come in two layouts (Members/Enterprise/SecuritySettings vs Users/Files/RetentionPolicies); this path exists only in the first.

metrics.name: Two-Factor Required (tenant policy)
metrics.gotcha: Tenant-wide 2FA-required flag; Box exposes no per-user MFA field. Result is a boolean, not a count. Box dataprints come in two layouts (Members/Enterprise/SecuritySettings vs Users/Files/RetentionPolicies); this path exists only in the first.

metrics.name: Total User Count
metrics.gotcha: Box dataprints come in two layouts (Members/Enterprise/SecuritySettings vs Users/Files/RetentionPolicies); this path exists only in the first.
